title: CRUDUI declaration schema
description: Validates form and list declarations, including field structure, validation, appearance, behavior and composition.
$comment: Form declarations use the root entry. List declarations use definitions/List. Resolve external references before runtime rendering.

ForbiddenKeyNames.$comment: Restrictions on reserved declaration property names. Reused by field maps and settings objects.

OpenValue.description: Value the schema leaves open. Any JSON value is accepted; every object key at every depth must satisfy the property-name rules.

Expression.description: Expression string supporting relative paths, comparisons, logic, membership and conditional values. Behavior scripts are separate.

ConditionMap.description: Evaluates conditions in declaration order and selects the first matching value. The literal true key is the optional default, applied only after every other condition fails, whatever its position; with no match and no default the result is null.

LangMap.description: Content translations indexed by language code. A null translation represents absent content.

Content.description: Content text or a language map. Null represents absent content.

Reference.description: Composition reference: one file path, or a list of paths resolved in declaration order where a later path overrides an earlier one. A path may select a fragment as (file.yml).key.

Messages.description: Error message overrides indexed by registered rule name; each message is a plain string. Any other rule name fails the load with UNKNOWN_RULE.

ChoicePair.description: One choice: an option value and its display label.

ChoiceList.description: Choices in list order for any values. Each value is a string or a number whose canonical text is the option value; no two values have the same canonical text.

ChoiceItems.description: The choice list of a field's items. In a choice or multichoice field each choice may also declare the class and style of its label and the declared attributes of its input, and in a select field the list may contain groups of choices; binding rejects these members and groups in other fields.

style.description: Inline style of the choice's label.

attributes.description: Attributes written on the choice's input.

ChoiceGroup.description: A group of choices in the choice list of a select field or of the in rule: a label and one or more value and label pairs whose values are distinct across the whole list. Binding rejects a group in other fields.

choices.description: Choices of the group in list order.

GroupedChoiceList.description: A choice list whose elements are choices or groups of choices, in list order; the values of all choices are distinct by canonical text.

ItemLabel.description: Choice display label, optionally translated. The choice value is separate from its label.

Validate.description: Validation rules in declaration order. Only the registered rules are accepted, each with its typed parameter; any other rule name fails the load with UNKNOWN_RULE.

required.description: Requires a supplied, nonempty value when enabled.

email.description: Requires a syntactically valid email address when enabled.

url.description: Requires a valid URL when enabled.

minlength.description: Minimum length in Unicode code points of the value's canonical text.

maxlength.description: Maximum length in Unicode code points of the value's canonical text.

rangelength.description: Minimum and maximum length in Unicode code points of the value's canonical text.

number.description: Requires a numeric value (a finite number or numeric text) when enabled.

digits.description: Requires a value whose canonical text is ASCII digits only when enabled.

min.description: Inclusive numeric lower bound, a finite number.

max.description: Inclusive numeric upper bound, a finite number.

range.description: Inclusive numeric lower and upper bounds, finite numbers with the minimum not above the maximum.

match.description: Pattern in the CRUDUI pattern language that the whole value must match.

pattern.description: Same rule as match under the name used in messages.

equalTo.description: Field whose value must be equal.

containedIn.description: Field whose string value must contain the string value (CUVR-075).

typeFrom.description: Field whose value names the type of the value: bool, int or enum (CUVR-077).

minFrom.description: Field whose value is the inclusive lower bound of the value (CUVR-079).

maxFrom.description: Field whose value is the inclusive upper bound of the value (CUVR-079).

notEqual.description: Field reference starting with a dot, or a literal value the input must differ from. Passed unchanged.

in.description: Allowed values: a comma-separated string, a list, a choice list, with groups, whose values are the members, or a value-to-label map whose keys are the values. Members are nonempty strings, numbers or booleans; an empty list or map allows no value; a map is not a condition map.

date.description: Requires a valid date when enabled.

dateISO.description: Requires a YYYY-MM-DD date when enabled.

enddate.description: Start-date field; the end date must not precede it.

reference.description: Declaration path of a field of the form, such as facts.id; the value must name one of the ids that the data holds in that field.

unique.description: Uniqueness when enabled; a string names an item field or a filter condition, and a list names the fields of the row that the value is unique together with (CUVR-097). Passed unchanged.

accept.description: Accepted file extensions or MIME types, as a comma-separated string or a list. Passed unchanged.

conditionTree.description: The value is a condition tree; judge also permits judged text. Passed unchanged.

DesignNode.description: CSS classes and inline styles for a named DOM node.

class.description: CSS classes, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

style.description: Inline styles, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

DeclaredAttributes.description: Attributes a form field declares for an element: data-* or aria-* names that crudui does not write, each with a string value.

FieldWrapperNode.description: CSS classes, inline styles and declared attributes for the node root of a form field.

class.description: CSS classes, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

style.description: Inline styles, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

attributes.description: Attributes written on the node root.

Design.description: Visibility and appearance settings for the main node and named label, wrapper, group and prepend nodes.

class.description: CSS classes, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

style.description: Inline styles, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

label.description: Appearance settings for the label node.

wrapper.description: Appearance settings for the wrapper node.

group.description: Appearance settings for the group node.

prepend.description: Appearance settings for the prepend node.

FieldDesign.description: Visibility, appearance, declared attributes and the layout of a group of a form field: the control and the named label, wrapper, group and prepend nodes.

class.description: CSS classes, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

style.description: Inline styles, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

attributes.description: Attributes written on the field's control.

layout.description: Layout of the fields inside a group field: stacked, inline (a label column and a control column) or line (child nodes side by side).

editor.description: The editor of a condition field: text, the textarea of its JSON text, or structured, nested controls of its tree.

label.description: Appearance settings for the label node.

wrapper.description: Appearance settings and declared attributes for the wrapper node.

group.description: Appearance settings for the group node.

prepend.description: Appearance settings for the prepend node.

BehaviorAction.description: Opaque script string or an object containing a label and script. The expression engine does not execute scripts.

Behavior.description: Named client behavior scripts preserved independently of expression evaluation.

FormAction.description: Submission target of the form, kept unchanged. Honored on the form root only.

FormButton.description: One form button rendered in the form footer. A button or link needs text; a link needs href.

type.description: Button type. A link renders an anchor.

text.description: Button text, optionally translated. Submit and reset default to interface text.

Options.description: Widget-specific settings preserved for the corresponding widget implementation.

fields.description: The field names that the comparisons of a structured condition editor choose from.

marker_draggable.description: Whether the map marker can be dragged.

ItemsModel.description: Dynamic choice model descriptor with table, relations and display keys. CRUDUI runs no data query.

keys.description: Fields used to construct choice labels.

ItemsSource.description: Dynamic choice source descriptor. CRUDUI loads no records and runs no source callback.

model.description: Source model name or a descriptor containing table, relations and keys.

api_server.description: Opaque endpoint callback preserved unchanged and not run by CRUDUI.

items.description: Static initial choices within a dynamic source.

Items.description: Array of labels whose indexes are the values, choice list, value-to-label map or dynamic source descriptor. Labels may contain translations.

anyOf.description: Labels whose indexes are the values. An element that is an object with a value or a choices member makes the array a choice list.

LangOverrideMap.description: Language-code map containing per-language validation, appearance, behavior and widget-option overrides.

Lang.description: Language input settings, separate from content translations. Values are stored by language code.

only.description: Language-code list or per-language override map.

Multiple.description: Repeated rows use keyed instance data. Repetition options belong under multiple; row identity is carried by collection keys, without hidden identity fields. `only`, the same as `{ only: true }`, declares rows that exist only in the data: the data keys are the rows, missing data has no row, and the form offers no row controls or row operations.

anyOf.description: Rows that exist only in the data; the same as { only: true }.

only.description: Whether the rows exist only in the data. With true, only title, header and keys may accompany it.

copy.description: Whether repeated rows provide a copy control.

sortable.description: Whether repeated rows can be reordered.

title.description: Direct child field of a repeated group whose value titles each row.

header.description: Whether row headers stay visible while scrolling.

only.description: Whether the rows exist only in the data. With true, only title, header and keys may accompany it.

keys.description: Field reference to a repeated group of the form whose row keys are the only keys of this keyed map (docs/spec/schema.md, Keyed maps).

title.description: Direct child field of a repeated group whose value titles each row.

header.description: Whether row headers stay visible while scrolling.

Patch.description: Composition operations for adding, removing or replacing definition properties.

Properties.description: Child field map supporting composition references and patches. Child names must satisfy the property-name rules.

Field.description: Field declaration with structure, content, validation, appearance, behavior, type options and composition. Unrecognized field properties are rejected.

default.description: Default value used when a field value is absent.

items.description: Static choices or a dynamic choice source descriptor.

multiple.description: Repeated rows use keyed instance data. Repetition options belong under multiple; row identity is carried by collection keys, without hidden identity fields. `only`, the same as `{ only: true }`, declares rows that exist only in the data: the data keys are the rows, missing data has no row, and the form offers no row controls or row operations.

content.description: Control text of a button or action field, optionally translated.

messages.description: Error message overrides by rule name. A message is a plain string; the display language is not selected here.

buttons.description: Form buttons in the form footer; one submit button when absent. Honored on the form root only.

action.description: Submission target of the form. Honored on the form root only.

dataLimits.description: Bounds of the submitted data: its levels and its nodes (CUVR-082). Honored on the form root only.

$patch.description: Composition operations applied after reference resolution.

allOf.description: A range field declares literal bounds and a literal step (docs/spec/schema.md, Range fields); a field with $ref receives them by composition.
A condition field declares the literal validate.conditionTree true or judge (docs/spec/schema.md, Condition fields); a field with $ref receives it by composition.
Only a group field declares design.layout (docs/spec/schema.md, Layout).
Only a condition field declares design.editor (docs/spec/schema.md, Structured condition editor).
A repeated group declares no line layout.

CellFormat.description: Cell display format as a type name or an object with format-specific settings.

anyOf.description: Cell format type name without additional settings.

map.description: Value-to-badge mapping with optional translated labels.

text.description: Link text, optionally translated. The value is used when text is absent.

items.description: Static choices or a dynamic choice source descriptor.

as.description: Boolean display mode: text, icon or check.

alt.description: Image alternative text supporting field interpolation.

DisplayField.description: Read-only display field declaration specifying the value path, label, display format and appearance.

format.description: Cell display format. The default is text.

$patch.description: Composition operations applied after reference resolution.

Column.description: List column declaration specifying the value path, label, display format, appearance and sorting availability.

format.description: Cell display format. The default is text.

sortable.description: Whether sorting by this column is available, optionally selected by an expression or condition map; a map that selects nothing is false. CRUDUI does not sort row data.

$patch.description: Composition operations applied after reference resolution.

Sort.description: Sort declaration. CRUDUI does not reorder row data.

Pagination.description: Pagination declaration. CRUDUI renders the supplied rows and does not select a page of row data.

per_page.description: Requested rows per page: a safe integer of at least 1.

mode.description: Pagination mode: pages, offset, cursor or none.

ListAction.description: List or detail action script or an object containing label, format, behavior and appearance settings.

format.description: Cell display format. The default is text.

Columns.description: Named list column map supporting composition references and patches.

DetailFields.description: Named detail field map supporting composition references and patches.

Detail.description: Detail declaration with ordered read-only display fields and actions. One record is supplied separately.

List.description: List declaration with columns, search, sorting, pagination, actions, empty content and a description. Row data is supplied separately. The server applies searching, sorting and pagination.

sort.description: Requested sort configuration; CRUDUI declares it and does not sort row data.

pagination.description: Requested pagination configuration; CRUDUI declares it and does not page row data.

description.description: Description content written before the list, optionally translated.

$patch.description: Composition operations applied after reference resolution.

RuleSwitch.description: Boolean rule enablement, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

RuleNumber.description: Numeric rule parameter, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

RuleLength.description: Length limit in Unicode code points of the value's canonical text: an integer from 0 to 9007199254740991, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

RuleBounds.description: Minimum and maximum rule parameter, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

RuleLengthBounds.description: Minimum and maximum length in Unicode code points, integers from 0 to 9007199254740991 with the minimum not above the maximum, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.

RuleFieldReference.description: Field reference passed to the rule unchanged; not evaluated as a condition.

RulePattern.description: Pattern string in the CRUDUI pattern language, passed to the rule unchanged; not evaluated as a condition. The whole value must match.

RuleStep.description: Step rule parameter: a finite number above 0, optionally selected by an expression or condition map.
